questions.question: The two equations are 4x + 4ky - 6 = 0 and x + 6y - 12 = 0. Find the value of k for the pair of two linear equations represents the parallel lines.
questions.solution:

If two lines a1x + b1y + c1 = 0 and a2x + b2y + c2 = 0 are parallel then (a₁)/(a₂) = (b₁)/(b₂) ne (c₁)/(c₂)

**Calculation:**

Compare the eq. with a₁x + b₁y + c₁ = 0

⇒ a₁ = 4, b₁ = 4k, c₁ = - 6

{m₁} = - frac{{{a₁}}}{{{b₁}}} = - (4)/({4k)} = - (1)/(k)

Equation of 2ⁿd line x + 6y - 12 = 0

questions.question:
Two circles have radii 6 cm and 3 cm and are centered at the point P and Q, respectively. A transverse common tangent AC to both circles cuts the line joining P and Q at a point B such that AB = 8 cm. Find the length (in cm) of PQ.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f29ccf0537dcd94b46cff191295f3df16b40f1afa626bedb9778e7825c258e57.png]
questions.solution:
In ΔPAB,

PB² = AB² + AP²

PB² = 8² + 6² = 64 + 36 = 100

⇒ PB = 10 cm

ΔPAB and ΔBQC are similar triangle.

So, AB/BC = AP/QC

⇒ 8/BC = 6/3

⇒ BC = 4 cm

In ΔBQC,

BQ² = BC² + QC²

⇒ BQ² = 4² + 3² = 25

⇒ BQ = 5 cm

∴ PQ = PB + BQ = 10 + 5 = 15 cm

questions.question: The circle of radius 4 cm and centre O has a tangent PR. If ∠POR = 90° and OR = 7 cm and OP = 24 cm. Calculate the length (in cm) of PR.

According to Pythagoras theorem, 

Hypotenuse² = Perpendicular² + Base²

questions.question: In an election between two candidates, the winning candidate got 70% of the valid votes and won by a majority of 9000 votes. If out of total votes polled 90% votes are valid, then what is the total number of votes polled?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Valid votes of winning candidate = 70%

Valid votes of losing candidate = 30%

Difference of valid votes of winning and losing candidates = 70% - 30% = 40%

⇒ 40% = 9000

⇒ 10% = 2250

⇒ 100% = 22500 = total valid votes

**∴ Total no. of votes polled = 22500 × 100/90 = 25000**

questions.question: 7 litres mixture of milk and water contains 30% water. 3.5 litres of milk is added to this mixture. What is the percentage of water in the new mixture?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Quantity of water in the mixture = 30% of 7 litres = 2.1 litre

Quantity of milk in the mixture = 7 - 2.1 = 4.9 litres

New quantity of milk in the mixture after adding 3.5 litres of milk = 4.9 + 3.5 = 8.4 litres

Quantity of New mixture = 8.4 + 2.1 = 10.5 litres

**∴ Percentage of water in new mixture = 2.1/10.5 × 100 = 20%**

The difference between simple interest on a certain sum at the rate of 6% per annum for 5 years and 6 years is 25.8. What is the sum (in Rs)?
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

Simple Interest. = (P × R × (T₂ - T₁))/100

Where, P = principal, R = rate and T₁, T₂ are time

**Calculation:**

S.I. = (P × R × (T2 - T1))/100

⇒ 25.8 = (P × 6 × (6 - 5))/100

⇒ 25.8 = (P × 6 × 1)/100

**∴ P = (25.8 × 100)/6 = 430**

questions.question:
A shopkeeper offers the following 3 schemes. Which scheme has the lowest discount percentage (all articles have same marked price)?

**I. Two successive discounts of 10% and 10%**

**II. Buy 7 get 8**

**III. Buy 9 get 1 free**
questions.solution:
**Solution:**

Let the market price of the article is Rs. 100

Case I: Discount % = 10 + 10 - (10 × 10) /100 = 20 - 1 = 19%

Case II: Discount % = (Free item / total item )× 100

= 1/8 × 100 =12.5%

Case III: Discount % = (Free item / total item )× 100

= 1/10 × 100 = 10%

**Hence, Case III scheme has the lowest discount percentage**

questions.question: X can complete 5/7 part of a work in 10 days and Y can complete 3/4 part of the same work in 9 days. In how many days will both complete 13/21 part of the total work
questions.solution:
**Given:**

X can complete 5/7 part of a work in 10 days.

Y can complete 3/4 part of the same work in 9 days.

**Concept:-**

Basic time and work concept.

**Calculation:-**

Time taken by X to complete 5/7 part of a work = 10 days

Time taken by X to complete the whole work = 10 × 7/5

⇒ 14 days

Time taken by Y to complete 3/4 part of a work = 9 days

Time taken by Y to complete the whole work = 9 × 4/3

⇒ 12 days

Total work = LCM of (12 and 14)

⇒ 84 units

Efficiency of X = 84/12

⇒ 7 units/day

Efficiency of Y = 84/14

⇒ 6 units/day

Efficiency of X + Y together = 7 + 6

⇒ 13 units/day

Total time taken by X + Y together to complete 13/21 part of the work = 84 × 13/21 × 1/13

⇒ 4 days

**∴ In 4 days will both complete 13/21 part of the total work.**

questions.question: A train starts from a place A at 8 : 00 a.m. and arrives at another place B at 1 : 30 p.m. on the same day. If the speed of the train is 30 km/hr, then what will be the distance (in km) covered by the train?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Time taken by train to reach B from A = 5(1)/(2) = frac{{11}}{2} hours

Distance travelled by the train = Speed × Time

**∴ Distance travelled by the train = 30 × 11/2 = 165 km**

questions.question: If the measure of the interior angle of a regular polygon is 108° then how many sides does it have?
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

Let number of sides are N

Interior angle = 180° - (360°)/N

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

⇒ 108° = 180° - (360°)/N

⇒ (360°)/N = 180° - 108° = 72°

⇒ (360°)/(72°) = N

**∴ N = 5**
